description: This file defines the interface for the Starboard System module, including system properties, paths, capabilities, error handling, and system control functions. It provides APIs for querying system info, managing application states, and handling errors.

methods.name: SbSystemRaisePlatformError
methods.description: Handles platform-specific error reporting, notifying the user and providing interaction mechanisms.

methods.name: SbSystemBreakIntoDebugger
methods.description: Breaks into debugger if attached, otherwise aborts the program.

methods.name: SbSystemIsDebuggerAttached
methods.description: Checks if a debugger is attached to the current process.

methods.name: SbSystemGetNumberOfProcessors
methods.description: Returns the number of processor cores available.

methods.name: SbSystemGetTotalCPUMemory
methods.description: Returns total CPU memory available to the application.

methods.name: SbSystemGetUsedCPUMemory
methods.description: Returns CPU memory currently used by the application.

methods.name: SbSystemGetTotalGPUMemory
methods.description: Returns total GPU memory available, if supported.

methods.name: SbSystemGetUsedGPUMemory
methods.description: Returns GPU memory currently used, if supported.

methods.name: SbSystemGetPath
methods.description: Retrieves system paths based on path ID.

methods.name: SbSystemGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves system properties based on property ID.

methods.name: SbSystemHasCapability
methods.description: Checks if a runtime capability is supported.

methods.name: SbSystemGetLocaleId
methods.description: Returns the current POSIX-style locale ID.

methods.name: SbSystemGetRandomUInt64
methods.description: Generates 64 cryptographically secure random bits.

methods.name: SbSystemGetRandomData
methods.description: Fills buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: SbSystemGetLastError
methods.description: Returns last platform-specific error code.

methods.name: SbSystemClearLastError
methods.description: Clears the last error code.

methods.name: SbSystemGetErrorString
methods.description: Generates human-readable string for an error code.

methods.name: SbSystemGetStack
methods.description: Retrieves instruction pointer addresses of current stack.

methods.name: SbSystemSymbolize
methods.description: Looks up symbol for an instruction pointer address.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestBlur
methods.description: Requests application to move to blurred (unfocused) state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestFocus
methods.description: Requests application to move to focused (started) state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestConceal
methods.description: Requests application to move to concealed (minimized) state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestReveal
methods.description: Requests application to move to revealed (focused) state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestFreeze
methods.description: Requests application to move to frozen (suspended) state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestStop
methods.description: Requests graceful termination of the application.

methods.name: SbSystemHideSplashScreen
methods.description: Hides the splash screen if supported.

methods.name: SbSystemSupportsResume
methods.description: Indicates if resume after suspend is supported.

methods.name: SbSystemGetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves platform-specific extension implementations.

methods.name: SbSystemSignWithCertificationSecretKey
methods.description: Computes HMAC-SHA256 digest with certification secret.
